# Package states

Generated by the state test (`go test -run TestStates -update`); do not edit.

## Axes

- **source**: calendar, app
- **timing**: ahead, purchased
- **credits**: left, used-up
- **price**: free, priced
- **payment**: none, paid, waived
- **paid for**: current, outdated
- **invoice**: empty, draft, issued
- **receipt**: empty, draft, issued
- **drift**: none, drifted

## Rules

| rule | bucket | reason | why | resolved by / guarded by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| contradicts-document | contradiction | fix | The calendar changed after an invoice or receipt was issued: the event names another client, or moved | documents.revise, documents.cancel |
| price-changed-after-payment | contradiction | fix | The calendar changed the price after it was paid, and the amount paid doesn't match it | payments.set, sessions.update |
| unpaid | needs-action | collect | Bought outside the calendar, and not paid | payments.set |
| drift-without-issued-document | impossible |  | Drift compares the calendar with an issued document | by construction: the reconcile only sets drift against an issued document |
| outdated-without-payment | impossible |  | Only money received can settle an old price | by construction: Payment.Outdated holds only for a payment received |
| receipt-without-payment | impossible |  | A receipt confirms money received | documents.createDraft; payments.set |
